title: Rejection of an undecodable input
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans and let $x$ be a Boolean word that has no valid paired decoding. There is a time $u\le 5(|x|+1)$ at which the forward simulator on $x$ is halted with empty output. At every time $v$, the forward and non-forward simulators on $x$ have identical configurations.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
